title: M3 — Browser text encoding and hybrid search
description: Pinned q8 CLAP text-only WASM encoder in lazy Web Worker. Immediate unchanged lexical results plus automatic sound groups after600ms or Enter. Cache, progress, retry, cancellation and stale response guards. Global/Samples/Clips integration with existing filters; saved clips only in Clips. Depends M0 and M1. WebGPU excluded.
right_now_summary: Hybrid search works in local browser checks, but first-use browser acceptance is still pending.
